programs.source:
AttributeCharts =: ' ' split 'p np c u'
center_line =: 4 : 0
    defectives =. defects =. inspected =. 0
    for_box. y do.
        lot =. >box
        defectives =. defectives+'defectives' get_key lot
        defects =. defects+'defects' get_key lot
        inspected =. inspected+'inspected' get_key lot
    end.
    fraction =. (real defectives)%real inspected
    select. x
    case. 'p' do. value =. fraction
    case. 'np' do. value =. (real defectives)%real #y
    case. 'c' do. value =. (real defects)%real #y
    case. 'u' do. value =. (real defects)%real inspected
    end.
    'chart value fraction' record (<x),(<value),<fraction
)
lot_point =: 4 : 0
    chart =. 'chart' get_key x
    cl =. 'value' get_key x
    inspected =. real 'inspected' get_key y
    select. chart
    case. 'p' do.
        value =. (real 'defectives' get_key y)%inspected
        sigma =. %:(cl*(1.0-cl))%inspected
    case. 'np' do.
        value =. 'defectives' get_key y
        sigma =. %:cl*1.0-'fraction' get_key x
    case. 'c' do.
        value =. 'defects' get_key y
        sigma =. %:cl
    case. 'u' do.
        value =. (real 'defects' get_key y)%inspected
        sigma =. %:cl%inspected
    end.
    lcl =. 0.0>.cl-3.0*sigma
    ucl =. cl+3.0*sigma
    z =. (value-cl)%sigma
    if. value>!.0 ucl do. status =. 'high'
    elseif. value<!.0 lcl do. status =. 'low'
    else. status =. 'ok' end.
    'value lcl ucl z status' record (<value),(<lcl),(<ucl),(<z),<status
)

capability_indices =: 4 : 0
    lsl =. 'lsl' get_key Settings
    usl =. 'usl' get_key Settings
    potential =. (real usl-lsl)%(6.0*y)
    upper =. (usl-x)%(3.0*y)
    lower =. (x-lsl)%(3.0*y)
    potential,upper,lower,upper<.lower
)
confidence_interval =: 4 : 0
    first =. 1.0%(9.0*real y)
    second =. (x*x)%(2.0*real y-1)
    delta =. ('ci_z' get_key Settings)*%:first+second
    (x-delta),x+delta
)
capability_verdict =: 3 : 0
    if. y>:!.0 1.33 do. 'capable'
    elseif. y>:!.0 1.0 do. 'marginal'
    else. 'incapable' end.
)
histogram_rows =: 3 : 0
    width =. 'histogram_bin' get_key Settings
    low =. width*((<./y)<.'lsl' get_key Settings) div width
    high =. width+width*((>./y)>.'usl' get_key Settings) div width
    frequencies =. ((high-low) div width)$0
    for_value. y do.
        index =. (value-low) div width
        frequencies =. (1+index{frequencies) index}frequencies
    end.
    top =. >./frequencies
    bins =. 0$a:
    for_index. i.#frequencies do.
        lower =. low+index*width
        upper =. lower+width-1
        frequency =. index{frequencies
        length =. ((50*frequency)+top-1) div top
        marks =. 0$a:
        for_namebox. ' ' split 'lsl target usl' do.
            point =. (>namebox) get_key Settings
            if. (point>:lower)*.point<:upper do. marks =. marks,namebox end.
        end.
        bins =. bins,<'lower upper frequency length marks' record (<lower),(<upper),(<frequency),(<length),<marks
    end.
    bins
)
capability =: 3 : 0
    values =. 0$0
    for_box. y do. values =. values,'values' get_key >box end.
    count =. #values
    mean =. (real +/values)%real count
    rbar =. (real +/'range' subgroup_totals y)%real #y
    sbar =. (real_sum 'sd' subgroup_totals y)%real #y
    within =. rbar%'d2' get_key Constants
    sbarsigma =. sbar%'c4' get_key Constants
    differences =. values-mean
    squares =. real_sum differences*differences
    overall =. %:squares%real count-1
    cp =. mean capability_indices within
    pp =. mean capability_indices overall
    offset =. mean-'target' get_key Settings
    width =. real ('usl' get_key Settings)-'lsl' get_key Settings
    cpm =. width%(6.0*%:(overall*overall)+offset*offset)
    cpkci =. (3{cp) confidence_interval count
    ppkci =. (3{pp) confidence_interval count
    below =. +/values<'lsl' get_key Settings
    above =. +/values>'usl' get_key Settings
    ppm =. (real 1000000*below+above)%real count
    result =. 'count mean sigma_within sigma_sbar sigma_overall' record (<count),(<mean),(<within),(<sbarsigma),<overall
    updates =. 'cp cpu cpl cpk pp ppu ppl ppk' record <"0 cp,pp
    for_row. updates do. result =. row put_key result end.
    updates =. 'cpm cpk_ci ppk_ci below above ppm verdict bins' record (<cpm),(<cpkci),(<ppkci),(<below),(<above),(<ppm),(<capability_verdict 3{cp),<histogram_rows values
    for_row. updates do. result =. row put_key result end.
    result
)

ConstantTable =: 9 8$1.880 2.659 0 3.267 0 3.267 1.128 0.7979 1.023 1.954 0 2.568 0 2.574 1.693 0.8862 0.729 1.628 0 2.266 0 2.282 2.059 0.9213 0.577 1.427 0 2.089 0 2.114 2.326 0.9400 0.483 1.287 0.030 1.970 0 2.004 2.534 0.9515 0.419 1.182 0.118 1.882 0.076 1.924 2.704 0.9594 0.373 1.099 0.185 1.815 0.136 1.864 2.847 0.9650 0.337 1.032 0.239 1.761 0.184 1.816 2.970 0.9693 0.308 0.975 0.284 1.716 0.223 1.777 3.078 0.9727
control_constants =: 3 : '''a2 a3 b3 b4 d3 d4 d2 c4'' record <"0 (y-2){ConstantTable'
read_numeric_rows =: 3 : 0
    rows =. 0$a:
    for_box. }.read_lines y do. rows =. rows,<num&>',' split >box end.
    rows
)
read_dataset =: 3 : 0
    Settings =: Rules =: empty_table ''
    realnames =. ' ' split 'cusum_k cusum_h ewma_lambda ewma_l ci_z'
    for_box. read_lines 'spec.txt' do.
        words =. ' ' split >box
        name =. 0{::words
        if. name-:'rules' do. Rules =: ((1{words),<num&>2}.words) put_key Rules
        else.
            text =. 1{::words
            if. name-:'characteristic' do. value =. text
            elseif. (<name)e.realnames do. value =. real 0".text
            else. value =. num text end.
            Settings =: ((<name),<value) put_key Settings
        end.
    end.
    Size =: 'subgroup_size' get_key Settings
    Phase1 =: 'phase1_subgroups' get_key Settings
    Constants =: control_constants Size
    PairConstants =: control_constants 2
    Values =: 0$0
    for_box. read_numeric_rows 'measurements.csv' do. Values =: Values,2{>box end.
    Lots =: 0$a:
    for_box. read_numeric_rows 'attributes.csv' do.
        Lots =: Lots,<'number inspected defectives defects' record <"0 >box
    end.
    i.0
)

ScriptPath =: >{:4!:3''
SourceDirectory =: (1+>./_1,I.ScriptPath e.'/\'){.ScriptPath
Digits =: '0123456789'
div =: 4 : '_1 x:<.(x:x)%x:y'
real =: 3 : '1.0*y'
num =: 3 : '10#.Digits i.y'
number =: 3 : 0
    if. y<0 do. '-',number -y return. end.
    text =. ''
    while. y>0 do.
        text =. ((10|y){Digits),text
        y =. y div 10
    end.
    if. #text do. text else. '0' end.
)
f4 =: 3 : 0
    negative =. y<!.0 0
    rounded =. <.!.0 ((|y)*10000.0)+0.5
    text =. (number rounded div 10000),'.',_4{.'0000',number 10000|rounded
    if. negative*.rounded~:0 do. '-',text else. text end.
)
split =: 4 : 0
    parts =. 0$a:
    while. 1 do.
        position =. y i.x
        parts =. parts,<position{.y
        if. position=#y do. parts return. end.
        y =. (position+1)}.y
    end.
)
join =: 4 : 0
    text =. ''
    for_index. i.#y do.
        if. index do. text =. text,x end.
        text =. text,index{::y
    end.
    text
)
text_line =: 3 : 0
    fields =. 0$a:
    for_box. y do.
        value =. >box
        if. 2=3!:0 value do. fields =. fields,<value
        else. fields =. fields,<number value end.
    end.
    ' ' join fields
)
add_line =: 3 : 0
    ReportLines =: ReportLines,<text_line y
    i.0
)
read_lines =: 3 : '<;._2 (1!:1 <''input/'',y)'
empty_table =: 3 : '0 2$a:'
table_keys =: 3 : '0{"1 y'
get_key =: 4 : '((table_keys y)i.<x){::1{"1 y'
put_key =: 4 : 0
    'key value' =. x
    position =. (table_keys y)i.<key
    if. position<#y do. (<value) (<position,1)}y
    else. y,1 2$(<key),<value end.
)
record =: 4 : '('' '' split x),.y'
number_list =: 3 : 0
    if. #y do. ' ' join number&.> <"0 /:~y else. 'none' end.
)
status_text =: 3 : 'y{::''stopped'';''converged'''
limits_text =: 4 : 'x,'' lcl '',(f4 ''lcl'' get_key y),'' cl '',(f4 ''cl'' get_key y),'' ucl '',f4 ''ucl'' get_key y'
load SourceDirectory,'dataset.ijs'
load SourceDirectory,'variable_charts.ijs'
load SourceDirectory,'attribute_charts.ijs'
load SourceDirectory,'run_rules.ijs'
load SourceDirectory,'capability.ijs'
load SourceDirectory,'plot.ijs'
ChartOrder =: ' ' split 'XBAR_R R XBAR_S S I MR CUSUM EWMA MA'
RuleOrder =: ' ' split '1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 UPPER LOWER'
Families =: ' ' split 'XBAR_R XBAR_S I_MR'
FamilyCharts =: 3 2$' ' split 'XBAR_R R XBAR_S S I MR'
FamilyLabels =: 3 2$' ' split 'XBAR R XBAR S I MR'
LocationCharts =: ' ' split 'XBAR_R XBAR_S I CUSUM EWMA MA'
EventTypes =: ' ' split 'SHIFT_UP SHIFT_DOWN SPREAD_UP SPREAD_DOWN PATTERN'
pair_text =: 4 : 0
    labels =. (Families i.<x){FamilyLabels
    ((0{::labels) limits_text 0{::y),' ',(1{::labels) limits_text 1{::y
)
family_limits =: 4 : 0
    if. x-:'I_MR' do. i_mr_limits (y-1){Values
    elseif. x-:'XBAR_R' do. xbar_r_limits (y-1){Subgroups
    else. xbar_s_limits (y-1){Subgroups end.
)
family_series =: 4 : 0
    if. x-:'I_MR' do.
        values =. (y-1){Values
        (<(<y),<values),<(<}.y),<moving_ranges values
    else.
        groups =. (y-1){Subgroups
        if. x-:'XBAR_R' do. field =. 'range' else. field =. 'sd' end.
        (<(<y),<'mean' subgroup_totals groups),<(<y),<field subgroup_totals groups
    end.
)
estimate_family =: 3 : 0
    count =. Phase1
    if. y-:'I_MR' do. count =. count*Size end.
    initial =. >:i.count
    points =. initial
    passes =. 0$a:
    converged =. 0
    for_pass. >:i.'max_passes' get_key Settings do.
        limits =. y family_limits points
        series =. y family_series points
        outliers =. 0$0
        for_index. i.2 do.
            'numbers values' =. index{::series
            outliers =. outliers,((index{::limits) outside values)#numbers
        end.
        outliers =. /:~~.outliers
        passes =. passes,<'points limits outliers' record (<#points),(<limits),<outliers
        if. 0=#outliers do. converged =. 1
            break.
        end.
        if. pass<'max_passes' get_key Settings do. points =. points-.outliers end.
    end.
    'passes converged limits retained removed' record (<passes),(<converged),(<limits),(<points),<initial-.points
)
chart_limits =: 3 : 0
    position =. ChartOrder i.<y
    family =. (position div 2){::Families
    (2|position){::'limits' get_key family get_key Estimates
)
signal_subgroup =: 3 : 0
    last =. 'end' get_key y
    if. (<'chart' get_key y)e.'I';'MR' do. 1+(last-1) div Size else. last end.
)
event_of =: 3 : 0
    for_box. Events do.
        event =. >box
        if. (y>:'start' get_key event)*.y<:'end' get_key event do. event return. end.
    end.
    empty_table ''
)
has_signal =: 3 : 0
    'chart last rule' =. y
    for_box. Signals do.
        signal =. >box
        if. (chart-:'chart' get_key signal)*.last='end' get_key signal do.
            if. (0=#rule)+.rule-:'rule' get_key signal do. 1 return. end.
        end.
    end.
    0
)
chart_signals =: 4 : 0
    chosen =. 0$a:
    for_box. y do. if. x-:'chart' get_key >box do. chosen =. chosen,box end. end.
    chosen
)
build_events =: 3 : 0
    groups =. 0$0
    for_box. Signals do. groups =. groups,signal_subgroup >box end.
    Events =: 0$a:
    for_group. /:~~.groups do.
        extend =. 0
        if. #Events do. extend =. ((group-('end' get_key >{:Events))-1)<:'event_gap' get_key Settings end.
        if. extend do.
            event =. ((<'end'),<group) put_key >{:Events
            Events =: (<event) (<:#Events)}Events
        else.
            Events =: Events,<'number start end' record (<1+#Events),(<group),<group
        end.
    end.
    for_index. i.#Events do.
        event =. index{::Events
        first =. 'start' get_key event
        last =. 'end' get_key event
        signals =. ((groups>:first)*.groups<:last)#Signals
        counts =. 5$0
        starts =. 0$0
        for_box. signals do.
            signal =. >box
            direction =. 'direction' get_key signal
            chart =. 'chart' get_key signal
            if. direction-:'NONE' do. kind =. 4
            elseif. (<chart)e.LocationCharts do. kind =. -.direction-:'UP'
            else. kind =. 2+-.direction-:'UP' end.
            counts =. (1+kind{counts) kind}counts
            if. chart-:'CUSUM' do. starts =. starts,'start' get_key signal end.
        end.
        onset =. first
        if. #starts do. onset =. <./starts end.
        length =. 1+last-first
        covered =. ((first-1)+i.length){Subgroups
        mean =. (real +/'total' subgroup_totals covered)%real Size*length
        shift =. (mean-Mu0)%Sigma
        spread =. ((real_sum 'sd' subgroup_totals covered)%real length)%Sbar
        values =. 0$0
        for_coveredbox. covered do. values =. values,'values' get_key >coveredbox end.
        outofspec =. +/(values<'lsl' get_key Settings)+.values>'usl' get_key Settings
        detection =. 0$0
        for_chartbox. ChartOrder do.
            selected =. (>chartbox) chart_signals signals
            firstsignal =. 0
            if. #selected do. firstsignal =. <./signal_subgroup&>selected end.
            detection =. detection,firstsignal
        end.
        updates =. 'signals counts kind onset shift spread out_of_spec detection' record (<signals),(<counts),(<(counts i.>./counts){::EventTypes),(<onset),(<shift),(<spread),(<outofspec),<detection
        for_row. updates do. event =. row put_key event end.
        Events =: (<event) index}Events
    end.
    i.0
)
estimate_attribute =: 3 : 0
    lots =. Lots
    passes =. 0$a:
    converged =. 0
    for_pass. >:i.'max_passes' get_key Settings do.
        center =. y center_line lots
        outliers =. 0$0
        for_box. lots do.
            lot =. >box
            point =. center lot_point lot
            if. -.'ok'-:'status' get_key point do. outliers =. outliers,'number' get_key lot end.
        end.
        passes =. passes,<'lots center outliers' record (<#lots),(<'value' get_key center),<outliers
        if. 0=#outliers do. converged =. 1
            break.
        end.
        if. pass<'max_passes' get_key Settings do. lots =. (-.('number' subgroup_totals lots)e.outliers)#lots end.
    end.
    retained =. 'number' subgroup_totals lots
    points =. 0$a:
    for_box. Lots do. points =. points,<center lot_point >box end.
    numbers =. >:i.#Lots
    signals =. check_rules (<y),(<numbers),(<'z' subgroup_totals points),(<new_limits _3 0 3),<'STD' get_key Rules
    'chart passes converged retained removed points signals' record (<y),(<passes),(<converged),(<#retained),(<numbers-.retained),(<points),<signals
)
run_analysis =: 3 : 0
    Subgroups =: subgroup_statistics Values
    Estimates =: empty_table ''
    for_familybox. Families do.
        family =. >familybox
        Estimates =: ((<family),<estimate_family family) put_key Estimates
    end.
    PatternChecks =: 0$a:
    for_familybox. Families do.
        family =. >familybox
        estimate =. family get_key Estimates
        series =. family family_series 'retained' get_key estimate
        charts =. (Families i.<family){FamilyCharts
        limits =. 'limits' get_key estimate
        for_index. i.2 do.
            chart =. index{::charts
            'numbers values' =. index{::series
            signals =. check_rules (<chart),(<numbers),(<values),(index{limits),<chart get_key Rules
            PatternChecks =: PatternChecks,<'chart points signals' record (<chart),(<#values),<signals
        end.
    end.
    Mu0 =: 'cl' get_key chart_limits 'XBAR_R'
    Sigma =: (('cl' get_key chart_limits 'R')%'d2' get_key Constants)% %:real Size
    Reference =: ('cusum_k' get_key Settings)*Sigma
    Interval =: ('cusum_h' get_key Settings)*Sigma
    Sbar =: 'cl' get_key chart_limits 'S'
    Phase2 =: (Phase1+1)+i.(#Subgroups)-Phase1
    samples =. ((Phase1*Size)+1)+i.(#Values)-Phase1*Size
    Signals =: 0$a:
    for_chartbox. 6{.ChartOrder do.
        chart =. >chartbox
        if. (<chart)e.'I';'MR' do.
            numbers =. samples
            observed =. (samples-1){Values
            if. chart-:'MR' do. observed =. |observed-(samples-2){Values end.
        else.
            numbers =. Phase2
            if. (<chart)e.'XBAR_R';'XBAR_S' do. field =. 'mean'
            elseif. chart-:'R' do. field =. 'range'
            else. field =. 'sd' end.
            observed =. field subgroup_totals (numbers-1){Subgroups
        end.
        Signals =: Signals,check_rules (<chart),(<numbers),(<observed),(<chart_limits chart),<chart get_key Rules
    end.
    upper =. lower =. 0.0
    upperrun =. lowerrun =. 0
    Cusum =: Ewma =: MovingAverage =: 0$a:
    smoothed =. Mu0
    factor =. 1.0
    lambda =. 'ewma_lambda' get_key Settings
    decay =. (1.0-lambda)*(1.0-lambda)
    ratio =. lambda%(2.0-lambda)
    ewsigma =. ('ewma_l' get_key Settings)*Sigma
    EwmaWidth =: ewsigma*%:ratio
    MaWidth =: (3.0*Sigma)% %:real 'ma_span' get_key Settings
    for_groupnumber. Phase2 do.
        group =. (groupnumber-1){::Subgroups
        mean =. 'mean' get_key group
        upper =. 0.0>.upper+((mean-Mu0)-Reference)
        lower =. 0.0>.lower+((Mu0-mean)-Reference)
        if. upper>!.0 0 do. upperrun =. upperrun+1 else. upperrun =. 0 end.
        if. lower>!.0 0 do. lowerrun =. lowerrun+1 else. lowerrun =. 0 end.
        Cusum =: Cusum,<'subgroup upper lower' record (<groupnumber),(<upper),<lower
        if. upper>!.0 Interval do.
            Signals =: Signals,<new_signal (<'CUSUM'),(<'UPPER'),(<1+groupnumber-upperrun),(<groupnumber),(<upper),<'UP'
            upper =. 0.0
            upperrun =. 0
        end.
        if. lower>!.0 Interval do.
            Signals =: Signals,<new_signal (<'CUSUM'),(<'LOWER'),(<1+groupnumber-lowerrun),(<groupnumber),(<lower),<'DOWN'
            lower =. 0.0
            lowerrun =. 0
        end.
        smoothed =. (lambda*mean)+((1.0-lambda)*smoothed)
        factor =. factor*decay
        width =. ewsigma*%:ratio*(1.0-factor)
        ewma =. 'subgroup value width lcl ucl' record (<groupnumber),(<smoothed),(<width),(<Mu0-width),<Mu0+width
        Ewma =: Ewma,<ewma
        first =. (Phase1+1)>.1+groupnumber-'ma_span' get_key Settings
        count =. 1+groupnumber-first
        groups =. ((first-1)+i.count){Subgroups
        total =. +/'total' subgroup_totals groups
        width =. (3.0*Sigma)% %:real count
        value =. (real total)%real Size*count
        ma =. 'subgroup value width lcl ucl' record (<groupnumber),(<value),(<width),(<Mu0-width),<Mu0+width
        MovingAverage =: MovingAverage,<ma
        for_index. i.2 do.
            chart =. index{::'EWMA';'MA'
            point =. index{::(<ewma),<ma
            start =. index{groupnumber,first
            value =. 'value' get_key point
            if. value>!.0 'ucl' get_key point do. direction =. 'UP'
                rule =. 'UPPER'
            elseif. value<!.0 'lcl' get_key point do. direction =. 'DOWN'
                rule =. 'LOWER'
            else. continue. end.
            Signals =: Signals,<new_signal (<chart),(<rule),(<start),(<groupnumber),(<value),<direction
        end.
    end.
    keys =. 0 3$0
    for_box. Signals do.
        signal =. >box
        keys =. keys,((ChartOrder i.<'chart' get_key signal),('end' get_key signal),RuleOrder i.<'rule' get_key signal)
    end.
    Signals =: (/:keys){Signals
    build_events ''
    free =. 0$0
    for_groupnumber. Phase2 do. if. 0=#event_of groupnumber do. free =. free,groupnumber end. end.
    Proposals =: 0$a:
    for_familybox. Families do.
        family =. >familybox
        added =. free
        if. family-:'I_MR' do.
            added =. 0$0
            for_groupnumber. free do. added =. added,((groupnumber-1)*Size)+>:i.Size end.
        end.
        numbers =. ('retained' get_key family get_key Estimates),added
        Proposals =: Proposals,<'family points limits' record (<family),(<#numbers),<family family_limits numbers
    end.
    AttributeResults =: estimate_attribute&.>AttributeCharts
    CapabilityGroups =: 0$a:
    for_namebox. 'phase1';'phase2' do.
        name =. >namebox
        if. name-:'phase1' do. numbers =. 'retained' get_key 'XBAR_R' get_key Estimates else. numbers =. Phase2 end.
        groups =. (numbers-1){Subgroups
        CapabilityGroups =: CapabilityGroups,<'name subgroups result' record (<name),(<groups),<capability groups
    end.
    Rolling =: 0$a:
    first =. Phase1+1
    length =. 'rolling_window' get_key Settings
    while. (first+length-1)<:#Subgroups do.
        last =. first+length-1
        groups =. ((first-1)+i.length){Subgroups
        Rolling =: Rolling,<'first last result' record (<first),(<last),<capability groups
        first =. first+'rolling_step' get_key Settings
    end.
    i.0
)
limits_lines =: 3 : 0
    ReportLines =: 0$a:
    add_line (<'characteristic'),<'characteristic' get_key Settings
    add_line (<'subgroup_size'),<Size
    add_line (<'subgroups'),<#Subgroups
    add_line (<'samples'),<#Values
    add_line (<'phase1_subgroups'),<Phase1
    for_familybox. Families do.
        family =. >familybox
        estimate =. family get_key Estimates
        add_line (<'family'),<family
        passes =. 'passes' get_key estimate
        for_index. i.#passes do.
            pass =. index{::passes

main ''

place =: 4 : 0
    'position symbol' =. y
    symbol (0>.60<.position)}x
)
framed_band =: 3 : 0
    band =. 61#'.'
    band =. ':' 0 60}band
    band place (<y),<'|'
)
limits_band =: 4 : 0
    'value signalled' =. y
    lcl =. 'lcl' get_key x
    span =. ('ucl' get_key x)-lcl
    center =. <.!.0 (60.0*(('cl' get_key x)-lcl)%span)+0.5
    position =. <.!.0 (60.0*(value-lcl)%span)+0.5
    symbol =. signalled{::'o';'*'
    (framed_band center) place (<position),<symbol
)
cusum_band =: 3 : 0
    'upper lower threshold uppersignal lowersignal' =. y
    band =. framed_band 30
    if. lower>!.0 0 do.
        offset =. 30<.<.!.0 (30.0*lower%threshold)+0.5
        symbol =. lowersignal{::'-';'*'
        band =. band place (<30-offset),<symbol
    end.
    if. upper>!.0 0 do.
        offset =. 30<.<.!.0 (30.0*upper%threshold)+0.5
        symbol =. uppersignal{::'+';'*'
        band =. band place (<30+offset),<symbol
    end.
    band
)
width_band =: 3 : 0
    'scale width value center signalled' =. y
    band =. 61#'.'
    edge =. 30<.<.!.0 (30.0*width%scale)+0.5
    band =. band place (<30),<'|'
    band =. band place (<30-edge),<':'
    band =. band place (<30+edge),<':'
    position =. 30+<.!.0 (30.0*(value-center)%scale)+0.5
    symbol =. signalled{::'o';'*'
    band place (<position),<symbol
)
standard_band =: 4 : 0
    position =. 30+<.!.0 (10.0*x)+0.5
    symbol =. y{::'*';'o'
    (framed_band 30) place (<position),<symbol
)

zones =: 3 : 0
    'lcl cl ucl' =. >1{"1 y
    upper =. (ucl-cl)%3.0
    lower =. (cl-lcl)%3.0
    'lcl cl ucl u1 u2 l1 l2' record (<lcl),(<cl),(<ucl),(<cl+upper),(<cl+2.0*upper),(<cl-lower),<cl-2.0*lower
)
new_signal =: 3 : '''chart rule start end value direction'' record y'
rule_direction =: 4 : 0
    'window zone' =. y
    'lcl cl ucl u1 u2 l1 l2' =. >1{"1 zone
    value =. {:window
    select. x
    case. 1 do.
        if. (value>!.0 ucl)+.value<!.0 lcl do.
            if. value>!.0 cl do. 'UP' else. 'DOWN' end.
            return.
        end.
    case. 2;3 do.
        if. x=2 do. upper =. u2
        lower =. l2
        needed =. 2
        else. upper =. u1
        lower =. l1
        needed =. 4 end.
        if. (value>!.0 upper)*.(+/window>!.0 upper)>:needed do. 'UP' return. end.
        if. (value<!.0 lower)*.(+/window<!.0 lower)>:needed do. 'DOWN' return. end.
    case. 4 do.
        if. *./window>!.0 cl do. 'UP' return. end.
        if. *./window<!.0 cl do. 'DOWN' return. end.
    case. 5 do.
        differences =. (}.window)-}:window
        if. *./differences>!.0 0 do. 'UP' return. end.
        if. *./differences<!.0 0 do. 'DOWN' return. end.
    case. 6 do.
        differences =. (}.window)-}:window
        positive =. differences>!.0 0
        if. (*./differences~:!.0 0)*.*./(}:positive)~:}.positive do. 'NONE' return. end.
    case. 7 do.
        if. *./(window>!.0 l1)*.window<!.0 u1 do. 'NONE' return. end.
    case. 8 do.
        upper =. window>!.0 u1
        lower =. window<!.0 l1
        if. (*./upper+.lower)*.(+./upper)*.+./lower do. 'NONE' return. end.
    end.
    ''
)
check_rules =: 3 : 0
    'chart numbers values limits rules' =. y
    zone =. zones limits
    signals =. 0$a:
    for_index. i.#values do.
        for_rule. rules do.
            length =. (rule-1){1 3 5 8 6 14 15 8
            if. (index+1)<length do. continue. end.
            first =. index+1-length
            direction =. rule rule_direction (<length{.first}.values),<zone
            if. #direction do.
                valueset =. (<chart),(<number rule),(<first{numbers),(<index{numbers),(<index{values),<direction
                signals =. signals,<new_signal valueset
            end.
        end.
    end.
    signals
)

real_sum =: 3 : 0
    total =. 0.0
    for_value. y do. total =. total+value end.
    total

subgroup_statistics =: 3 : 0
    groups =. 0$a:
    for_index. i.(#y) div Size do.
        values =. Size{.(index*Size)}.y
        total =. +/values
        squares =. +/values*values
        mean =. (real total)%real Size
        range =. (>./values)-<./values
        numerator =. (Size*squares)-total*total
        denominator =. Size*Size-1
        sd =. %:(real numerator)%real denominator
        group =. 'number values total squares mean range sd' record (<index+1),(<values),(<total),(<squares),(<mean),(<range),<sd
        groups =. groups,<group
    end.
    groups
)
